select s.sim_id, s.tree_id, s.category_node_id, n.node_name as category_node_name, s.imei, s.iccid, s.phone_number, s.monthly_data_quota, s.activation_time, s.expire_time, s.current_data_usage, s.status, s.create_time, s.remark, case when b.bind_id is null then false else true end as bound, b.vehicle_id as bound_vehicle_id, v.plate_no as bound_plate_no from biz_sim_card s left join biz_tree_node n on n.node_id = s.category_node_id and n.del_flag = '0' left join biz_vehicle_equipment_bind b on b.equipment_type = '3' and b.equipment_id = s.sim_id and b.del_flag = '0' left join biz_vehicle v on v.id = b.vehicle_id and v.del_flag = 0
s.del_flag = '0' and s.status = '0' and (b.bind_id is null or b.vehicle_id = #{vehicleId})
and ( s.iccid like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.imei like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.phone_number like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
order by s.iccid asc, s.sim_id desc
